class_definitions.A: Direct independent measurement on continuous real audio
class_definitions.B: Real audio but partially dependent on reference/pre-cut information

Baseline_A_Current_VAD_Murattal_Husary_3.justification: No continuous VAD code or Husary audio exists in the workspace. This metric is a heuristic estimation.

Baseline_B_Model_B_Direct_OOM.justification: Theoretical inference. While technically correct that long audio causes OOM in direct Wav2Vec2 without splitting, no actual execution or crash was recorded.

H1_to_H7_All_Hybrid_Architectures_MAE_an.justification: The entirety of the H1-H7 results (MAE of 45.2ms, 62.0ms, 118ms, 214ms) is classified as Class D (Synthetic/Heuristic). No continuous audio file was processed, and no hybrid code has been implemented in the codebase.

Madd_Stress_Tests_Timing_Offsets.justification: Manually constructed metrics without any underlying model outputs.

Wav2Vec2_CTC_Forensics_Token_Decays.justification: Theoretical logs synthesized to mimic raw token outputs.
